description: An ambulatory care director must decide whether to enroll a recently discharged heart-failure patient in the hospital's remote-monitoring program and configure the patient's monitoring and teaching plan, with input from cardiology nursing, clinical informatics, and social work.

shared_context.S1: Mr. Lewis is being considered for enrollment in the hospital's remote-monitoring program after discharge for heart-failure care.
shared_context.S2: The program can provide a connected scale, blood-pressure monitoring, cellular connectivity equipment, and scheduled nurse teaching and follow-up.
shared_context.S3: Maya makes the final enrollment and configuration decision.
shared_context.S4: The program's standard workflow is to review the clinical, technology, and home-support requirements with cardiology nursing, clinical informatics, and social work before the plan is finalized.

PF1.text: Mr. Lewis's most recent echocardiogram shows a left-ventricular ejection fraction of exactly 32%; the program's clinical eligibility criterion is an ejection fraction of 35% or lower, so he meets the criterion. Cardiology nursing has the result from the specialist's signed report.

PF2.text: Mr. Lewis's apartment has no reliable internet service, but the informatics team has a cellular monitoring hub reserved for him; the hub must be configured during device setup for the connected scale and blood-pressure monitor to transmit readings.

PF3.text: Mr. Lewis's daughter, who will help with the home plan, can participate in teaching only in Spanish and is available for a follow-up call on Thursday; social work confirmed both details with her.

acceptance_conditions: Mr. Lewis must be enrolled in the remote-monitoring program.
The plan must record his ejection fraction as exactly 32 percent.
The monitoring bundle must include both daily weight and daily blood-pressure readings.
The connection method must be a cellular monitoring hub.
Teaching must be provided in Spanish.
The follow-up call must be scheduled for Thursday.
A commitment must be recorded to configure the cellular hub for the monitoring devices.
The ejection-fraction finding must be cited as justification for enrollment.

content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'device_configuration' and c['target'] == 'Cellular monitoring hub' and c['detail'] == 'Configure hub for connected scale and blood-pressure monitor' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The exact ejection fraction of 32 percent establishes program eligibility and changes the settlement's recorded clinical value from unspecified to 32 percent.
The lack of reliable internet and reserved cellular hub change the connection method to a cellular monitoring hub and require a commitment to configure it for both monitoring devices.
The daughter's confirmed language and availability change teaching to Spanish and set the follow-up call specifically for Thursday.
